quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Luka Doncic's offensive dominance and defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: Luka has never disappointed me on the offensive side of the ball.
quotes.quote: Luka has never disappointed me on the offensive side of the ball. I wanted to shine light on Gilbert Arenas because on Gil's arena, Gil told me, you should go at the defensive players too when they don't come back with something. I remember him saying that, which thank you Asor Thompson and Amin Thompson, because both of you came back with something and I would love to highlight you when we get on that show. But he said Luka's production on one side of the ball makes it to where he really doesn't care what he does on defense.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Luka Doncic's defensive mindset
quotes.excerpt: I feel like he really feels like when somebody scores, he's like, I ain't even going to waste my energy.
quotes.quote: I feel like he really feels like when somebody scores, he's like, I ain't even going to waste my energy because I know you can't guard me. And he doesn't do the shit that James Harden does where it's like, James, when he was going reckless like this, James was getting off the floor, booming that thing, taking contact. He put a little more pressure on his body. He ain't using it, so he's going to be able to do it for so long.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Cleveland Cavaliers' mental struggles
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a mental thing. We left off the season feeling like we let that first game slip.
quotes.quote: I think it's a mental thing. We left off the season feeling like we let that first game slip, which messed up our chances. And every time they start giving up a lead now, or even while they're going up in a lead, they're thinking, don't mess up. Cleveland needs to play to win. Do not play not to lose. I don't know if everybody understands that, but there's people that play in high school that will go up by 10 points and because there's no shot clock, they'll hold the ball at half court because they're playing not to lose.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Evan Mobley's role in the Cavaliers' offense
quotes.excerpt: Can y'all please have him put two halves together? Stop breaking up his halves.
quotes.quote: Evan Mobley does things all the time, which by the way, can y'all please have him put two halves together? Stop breaking up his halves. Don't let him score 15 in the first half and then y'all just forget. In the second, Kenny Atkinson's knock is the adjustments. They are the same. It's too little or not enough. They have to push pace. They have to get him easy buckets. Yeah, Kenny's going to make play calls, but where are the easy buckets?

quotes.quote: That's why I be telling people LaMelo Ball is so fucking underrated because let LaMelo Ball have Evan Mobley. You think he going to score less than a dub?

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Amen Thompson's verticality and timing
quotes.excerpt: It's only crazy because people don't realize how fast Amen Thompson gets in the air.
quotes.quote: It's only crazy because people don't realize how fast Amen Thompson gets in the air. And that's what I kept telling people. It's not that he can jump high, it's how fast he go up like D-Rose, bro. It's quick as hell and it don't look like it take much effort. But he knows, he knows in his mind the rim is 10 feet. I can get to at least 12 feet and I'm going to beat you to it.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Rockets' growth without Fred VanVleet
quotes.excerpt: The growth that he got to have because Fred VanVleet was out. Like we underestimated this shit.
quotes.quote: The growth that he got to have because Fred VanVleet was out. Like we underestimated this shit. But he got Cooper, he got Cooper Flagg in a way. He got to have the ball, make decisions, put some pressure on himself, but it's not real pressure because Fred is really supposed to deal with this shit. But I'm going to deal with it. I want the challenge. He wanted it though. He guarded everything, one through three, one through four. You know what I'm saying? He rebounded, he played hard, he missed some shots, but he took some shots.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Darius Acuff Jr.'s potential
quotes.excerpt: Darius Acuff Jr. has not shot the ball well so far, but he did score 33 points.
quotes.quote: Darius Acuff Jr. has not shot the ball well so far, but he did score 33 points against Portland with 12 of 12 of them being free throws. So we know that he knows how to get fouled.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the importance of player development for rookies
quotes.excerpt: You can't have stuff like that happen though where guys are in contract years.
quotes.quote: You can't have stuff like that happen though where guys are in contract years. They got stuff that they need to do and they have to watch a young rookie develop. You're right now, you're the young player we're trying to develop. If you have guys over there that are, you know, they're on their last leg of trying to figure it out or they need to make this work this year or whatever, it's like they can start to react a certain way just because, you know, they got other stuff on their mind. They don't want to watch you dribble a whole possession. That's all he was saying. Give it up, give it back. That's it. Give it up, use some motion, go through a screen, something, or get the ball, hold it, calm everybody down so we don't feel like you just shake showing the whole possession.

quotes.excerpt: I don't think he's anything like Chet. That's why he's good.

So I think just his confidence alone to look and present a shot, sometimes people just have to know that you can get it rolling and that you could I used to get a dunk all the time just for being able to I wasn't a three-point shooter, but it was like they like, if Shump, he a streaky shooter and if Shump start hitting, we in for a long night.
